Owned legacy keeps the view-container Injector to preserve its existing constructor and uses a local helper that races zone stability with a stable afterNextRender callback, destroys the scheduled render handle on unsubscribe, and retains a zone-only fallback for a manually supplied injector without ApplicationRef. entries.subject: test: replace native date module with provider function (#32114)

They remove MatNativeDateModule/NativeDateModule imports from private fixture scopes, add provideNativeDateAdapter calls to providers, and change the private datepicker createComponent helper/calls and one describe label. Assertions, templates, locale values, custom direction/scroll provider objects and other operations are preserved by the bounded full-program normalization. Provider ordering is not declared equivalent for arbitrary custom overrides, especially the range helper adding the native factory after its provider spread. The owned form-field harness already configures that stable module through its modules-array API. Keep that setup and the public datepicker/harness integration; do not extend its private helper API or migrate fixtures solely for this upstream preference. This static source/provider-identity observation does not qualify actual DI lifetime, date behavior, browser, Sass, packed artifacts or floors.
